blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Alex Eala shifts her focus to the Asian Games 2026 tennis women’s doubles tournament Tuesday where she hits the court with partner Shaira Rivera. Eala and Rivera take on Hong Kong’s Kallista Liu and Ching Laam Lai at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center Show Court. Although Eala is playing doubles with Rivera for the first time, she is banking on her longtime friendship with her national team teammate. “Me and Ate Shai have known each other really long time.
